Job Summary

The Research Assistant II position in the Center for Asthma Research will process diverse human-study biospecimens, including work with cultured human airway epithelial cells and peripheral blood mononuclear cells. The ideal candidate will have prior experience working in a laboratory processing biospecimens and a strong understanding of standard laboratory processes. Responsibilities include biospecimen processing, tracking, running assays, database entry per protocol, organization and inventory management, and biospecimen quality assessment. The role also involves training, preparing materials, and presenting updates at lab staff meetings. The position is based in a three-person lab embedded within a larger multidisciplinary research team and requires the ability to work effectively and collaboratively in a team environment.

Key Responsibilities

Under moderate supervision, process human biospecimens with documentation of chain of custody
Conduct and evaluate experiments and assays
Understand and follow biospecimen processing and experimental protocols (tissue culture, etc.)
Record, compile, interpret, and communicate data/results
Follow VUMC safety protocols (may include use of combustibles, toxic material, and/or carcinogens)
Perform calculations involving molarity, % solutions, and serial dilutions
Prepare, operate and troubleshoot equipment in experimental procedures
Read and follow all equipment manuals
Ensure laboratory is prepared for experiments
Maintain inventories
Maintain sterile conditions as required
Prepare reagents
Demonstrate an understanding of acceptable procedures and techniques
Recognize problems and suggest solutions
Assist in modifications as directed
Provide appropriate written documentation of biospecimens and experiments
Prepare preliminary research progress reports
Summarize test results appropriately and prepare at laboratory meetings
Will require rotation to cover one Saturday a month, requiring 1-3 hours of work depending upon number of biospecimens and airway epithelial cells to be processed

Why Join Us?

The Center for Asthma Research is home to an innovative and interdisciplinary team committed to making a difference in the lives of children and families. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on groundbreaking studies, collaborate with leading experts across the country, and contribute to a mission-driven organization where your skills and leadership will be valued.

World-leading academic departments and comprehensive centers of excellence pursue scientific discoveries and transformational educational and clinical advances across the entire spectrum of health and disease.

Aligning with Vanderbilt Health’s Strategic Directions, the Office of Research provides shared research resources, administrative expertise and professional guidance to enable the trans-disciplinary environment and highly collaborative culture that advances discovery and training for all the research faculty, trainees, students and staff.

new_jobs.description:
Safety Data Analyst / Safety Risk Analyst

Boston,MA

DatePosted : 8/25/2026 12:22:27 PM

JobNumber : DTS1017187803

JobType : Contract

Skills: Safety Data Analytics, Quantitative Analysis, Statistical Analysis, Incident Analysis, Safety Risk Management, Trend Analysis, KPI Reporting, Data Modeling, Data Visualization, Technical Report Writing, White Papers, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, HFACS, SQL, Python, R, Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Word, PowerPoint, Risk Assessment, Safety Investigations, and Executive Reporting

Job Description

We are seeking a Safety Data Analyst / Safety Risk Analyst
to support safety risk management, incident analysis, trend identification, and data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate will have experience analyzing operational and incident data, developing statistical analyses, creating data visualizations, and producing detailed analytical reports for leadership and non-technical audiences.

This role will work closely with safety, investigation, risk management, and oversight teams to identify emerging hazards, evaluate mitigation effectiveness, and provide actionable insights to support organizational safety objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Develop high-quality, academically structured white-paper-style analytical reports examining key safety issues, emerging hazards, and operational trends.
Collect, clean, reconcile, and analyze data from multiple sources to identify safety trends and risk factors.
Prepare monthly analyses and reports tracking progress against annual safety Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Evaluate the effectiveness and impact of safety mitigations and communicate findings to senior leadership.
Prepare data packages and analytical materials to support Safety Investigations and investigative teams.
Develop ad hoc reports supporting Safety Risk Management activities, including incident and hazard analysis.
Analyze incident, operational, and safety data to identify trends requiring additional investigation or corrective action.
Work with State Safety Oversight Agency teams to evaluate mitigation progress and impacts associated with Risk-Based Inspection programs.
Develop clear and accurate charts, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate analytical findings.
Conduct literature reviews and incorporate relevant research into formal analytical reports.
Present complex analytical findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
Maintain accurate documentation, datasets, analytical methodologies, and reporting materials.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support safety initiatives and evidence-based decision-making.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Safety, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
An Associate degree or High School Diploma/GED with equivalent relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
At least 2 years of experience in data analytics, technical report writing, safety analysis, or a related field.
Strong experience with quantitative and statistical analysis.
Understanding of linear modeling, standard error, distributions, and variance.
Experience with data modeling concepts including joining, merging, summarizing, and sampling.
Excellent long-form technical and analytical writing skills.
Ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear reports for non-technical audiences.
Strong data visualization and presentation skills.
Excellent communication, organizational, and multitasking abilities.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Knowledge of causal factor identification and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
Familiarity with the Human Factors Analysis and Classification System (HFACS) framework.
Experience with SQL, R, and/or Python for data analysis and statistical modeling.
Experience working with safety, transportation, aviation, regulatory, inspection, or risk management data.
Experience supporting safety investigations or safety risk management programs.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst Field Reimbursement Management (FRM)
new_jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

The Field Reimbursement Management (FRM) Data Analyst is responsible for providing data analytics, reporting, and actionable business insights across multiple FRM programs, clients, therapeutic areas, and technology platforms. This role serves as a key cross-functional partner to FRM leadership, Operations, Client Services, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to ensure accurate, timely, and meaningful reporting of program performance.

The FRM Data Analyst will aggregate and analyze data from multiple sources and platforms to evaluate FRM activity, operational performance, key performance indicators (KPIs), program metrics, reimbursement trends, and overall FRM impact.

A primary responsibility of this position is ownership and support of reporting for Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), executive/client presentations, recurring program reporting, and ad hoc business requests.

The successful candidate will be able to translate complex data into clear insights and compelling business narratives that demonstrate FRM value, identify trends and access barriers, and support data-driven operational and strategic decisions.

Key Responsibilities

FRM Analytics & Performance Measurement

Analyze FRM performance across multiple programs, products, therapeutic areas, and client engagements.
Track and evaluate established KPIs, operational metrics, activity measures, and program outcomes.
Partner with FRM leadership and client teams to define appropriate metrics and KPIs based on individual program objectives and client expectations.
Evaluate relationships between FRM activities and measurable program outcomes to help demonstrate FRM impact and value.
Identify trends, opportunities, performance gaps, emerging reimbursement barriers, and areas requiring additional investigation.
Develop benchmarking and trending analyses across programs when appropriate.
Support leadership in evaluating individual, regional, team, and program-level performance.

MBR & QBR Reporting

Serve as a primary analytics resource for Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) across FRM programs.
Compile, validate, analyze, and prepare data required for recurring client and internal business reviews.
Partner with FRM leadership and Client Services to develop clear reporting narratives around program performance.
Translate raw data into executive-level insights, trends, observations, and recommendations.
Develop charts, tables, dashboards, and other visualizations that clearly communicate FRM performance and impact.
Maintain reporting calendars and proactively manage data requirements and deadlines for MBRs, QBRs, and other client deliverables.
Ensure consistent reporting methodologies and metric definitions across reporting periods.

Cross-Functional Data Management

Work cross-functionally with FRM Leadership, Operations, Client Services, Data & Analytics, IT, Finance, Training, HUB teams, and other internal stakeholders to gather and validate program data.
Collaborate with stakeholders across multiple client programs to understand reporting requirements and business objectives.
Serve as a liaison between operational teams and technical/data teams to translate business questions into reporting and analytical requirements.
Support alignment between FRM activity data and other available program data to provide a more comprehensive view of performance.
Establish strong working relationships with program leaders to understand program-specific workflows, data sources, client expectations, and reporting requirements.

Multi-Platform Reporting

Extract, aggregate, reconcile, and analyze information across multiple data sources and technology platforms.
Work with data originating from platforms such as CRM systems, Salesforce, Veeva, Power BI, FRM portals, HUB platforms, client systems, Excel-based trackers, and other reporting environments.
Identify inconsistencies or gaps between data sources and work with appropriate stakeholders to resolve data-quality concerns.
Maintain strong documentation regarding data definitions, source systems, reporting methodologies, and calculation logic.
Support the development of standardized reporting processes that reduce manual reporting and improve consistency across FRM programs.

Ad Hoc Analytics & Business Insights

Manage ad hoc reporting and analytical requests from FRM leadership, executive leadership, Client Services, and other business partners.
Conduct targeted analyses to answer operational and strategic business questions.
Provide rapid analysis when leadership needs visibility into emerging client concerns, reimbursement trends, access barriers, team activity, or operational performance.
Analyze historical and current performance to identify meaningful changes and potential drivers.
Provide data and analytical support for client proposals, RFPs, business development opportunities, program expansions, and strategic planning as needed.

Data Quality & Governance

Perform routine quality-control reviews to ensure reporting accuracy and completeness.
Validate data prior to inclusion in internal or client-facing reports.
Identify data integrity issues and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders for resolution.
Maintain standardized definitions and calculation methodologies for FRM metrics and KPIs.
Support development of reporting SOPs, data dictionaries, templates, and governance processes.
Ensure reporting is completed in accordance with applicable client requirements, contractual requirements, privacy standards, and organizational policies.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, Business, Finance, Information Systems, Life Sciences, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, operations analytics, or a related function.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, data reconciliation, and large dataset management.
Experience developing dashboards, reports, scorecards, and executive-level presentations.
Strong proficiency with PowerPoint and presentation-ready data visualization.
Experience working across multiple systems and data sources.
Ability to manage multiple programs, priorities, and reporting deadlines simultaneously.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare services, HUB services, patient services, market access, or field reimbursement environment.
Knowledge of the Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) role and provider reimbursement support model.
Experience working with Salesforce, Veeva, Power BI, CRM platforms, HUB platforms, FRM portals, or similar healthcare data environments.
Experience supporting client-facing MBRs, QBRs, executive business reviews, or operational performance reviews.
Ability to work with both structured and unstructured data and reconcile information from multiple platforms.

Core Competencies

Data Analysis & Interpretation
Healthcare & FRM Analytics
KPI Development & Performance Measurement
Data Visualization & Storytelling
MBR/QBR Reporting
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Client-Focused Reporting
Data Quality & Validation
Business Intelligence
Problem Solving
Attention to Detail
Project & Deadline Management
Executive Communication
Continuous Process Improvement

Success in This Role

Success will be demonstrated by the ability to provide accurate, consistent, timely, and actionable analytics across the FRM business
, while reducing the administrative reporting burden on FRM leadership and field teams.

The FRM Data Analyst will help create a scalable analytics infrastructure that allows leadership and clients to clearly understand what FRM teams are doing, where reimbursement and access barriers exist, how programs are performing against established KPIs, and where FRM engagement is making a measurable impact on provider access and patient journey outcomes
.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit for long periods of time, use hands to type, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Prefer candidates who can type at least 35 words per minute with 97% accuracy.
Although very minimal, flexibility to travel as needed is preferred.
This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, etc.

Why Work for Valeris?

We’re Committed To Supporting The Well-being And Success Of Our Team Members. As Part Of Our Organization, Full-time Employees Can Expect

Team members receive nine paid holidays plus two floating holidays
Opportunities for advancement in a company that supports personal and professional growth

A mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work makes a meaningful impact
